steps.title: Tuning
steps.text: The tune is the heart of the build. Your tune is custom written for your truck and the parts you choose below. The 2.8L tunes through EFI Live. Need the EFI Live device? Call or text (250) 261-9502.

options.name: EFI Live Custom Tuning
options.note: Choose your level, VIN licence and transmission tuning.

steps.title: Exhaust
steps.text: A full 3 inch exhaust for the 2.8L. Optional.

steps.title: EGR
steps.text: EGR kit. Optional. Skip it if you don't need it.
